pages.text: The c0de disk carries one program.$(br2)To copy a program onto the disk, right-click its PROGRAM block with the disk. This also works while the program runs. The tooltip of the disk shows the name of its program.

To build the program of a disk, right-click the floor at the start of an empty sheet (x=5, line 0). In survival mode, the blocks come from your inventory. A program with the same name must not exist yet.$(br2)To keep a program on your computer or to share it, use a disk drive.
A data item, an iron ingot and black dye, in any shape.
Before a big change, copy your program onto a disk. If the change goes wrong, delete the program and build it from the disk on an empty sheet.
The disk keeps everything: the blocks and the names, values and symbols of all LABEL, LITERAL and OPERATOR blocks.
